column4: ENCRYPT_METHOD MD5: new password hashes are weak
PASS_MAX_DAYS is 99999: passwords live longer than a year
UMASK 022 leaves new files readable by other users: use 027 or stricter
no complexity rule: set minclass to 3 or more, or negative dcredit, ucredit, lcredit and ocredit
enforcing = 0: weak passwords only produce a warning
PASS_MIN_DAYS is 0: a user can change a password straight back
PASS_WARN_AGE is 5: users get under a week of notice
